metaDescription: Markham Custom Flooring won our 2026 Flooring Installation award for Markham, Ontario. See services and where this GTA flooring company works.
summary: Markham Custom Flooring supplies and installs hardwood, laminate, vinyl plank and carpet for homeowners in Markham and the wider Greater Toronto Area. The business handles both product supply and installation from one shop.

editorial.heading: What they do
editorial.text: Markham Custom Flooring supplies and installs hardwood, engineered wood, laminate, vinyl plank and carpet, along with stair treads and area rugs. Covering both hard-surface flooring and carpet under one business lets a homeowner compare material options in one conversation rather than shopping separately for each.

editorial.heading: How they work
editorial.text: As a combined supply-and-install flooring company, the business is positioned to advise on material choice as well as handle the labour, which matters most on transitions between rooms and on stair treads, where fit and finish are harder to get right than on open flat runs.

editorial.heading: What to expect
editorial.text: No customer reviews are published for this listing yet, so base your decision on a direct conversation about materials, warranty and installation timeline. Ask to see samples of the specific hardwood species or vinyl plank pattern you are considering, since flooring can look different in a showroom sample than across a full room.

editorial.heading: Where they work
editorial.text: The company is based in Markham and serves Markham and the wider Greater Toronto Area. Homeowners outside Markham proper should confirm travel and delivery coverage before booking a measure or quote.

strengths: Covers hardwood, engineered wood, laminate, vinyl plank and carpet under one company.
Also installs stair treads, a detail-heavy job that benefits from specialist experience.
Supplies area rugs alongside hard flooring, useful for a full-room finish in one order.
Based in Markham with GTA-wide service, convenient for homeowners across the region.
considerations: No public reviews are listed yet, so ask for recent local references directly before committing.
Best suited to full-room or full-home flooring projects; confirm minimum job size for small repairs.
Material and installation lead times vary by product, especially for special-order hardwood species.
Expect a required in-home measure before final pricing on carpet and larger vinyl plank orders.
Not a fit if you need same-week installation on a special-order hardwood species, since custom material orders take time to arrive.
bestFor: Homeowners replacing flooring across multiple rooms in one project
Anyone comparing hardwood, laminate, vinyl plank and carpet before deciding
Homeowners who also need stair treads finished to match new flooring

questionsToAsk: What flooring warranty applies to materials versus your installation labour?
How do you handle subfloor prep and moisture testing before laying new flooring?
What is the typical lead time between measure, ordering and installation for our chosen material?
Can you match new stair treads to the flooring we choose for the adjoining rooms?
